failure_summary.description: Search results were not assigned and saved to cache.
Agents imported tools from unavailable modules instead of using the provided functions.
Agents changed supplied location or attraction-category values when forming tool arguments.
Agents treated an accepted offer or a new follow-up constraint as a no-op despite unsatisfied work.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly requires saving every result, so repeating that rule would not patch a content gap. Add concise guidance for the uncovered runtime-import and exact-value issues, and clarify how to interpret affirmative replies as actionable updates.

edits.content: - Resolve brief affirmative replies against the immediately preceding assistant question or offer. Treat an acceptance as a request for the offered action or preference, then check whether valid cached results actually satisfy it; do not treat the reply as a no-op merely because related results exist.

edits.target: ## Validate tool arguments and preserve user intent
edits.content: - Preserve user-supplied names and category values verbatim when placing them in schema-supported fields. Choose the field that matches the user's meaning, but do not translate, normalize, or replace a supplied value with a presumed synonym.

## Tool execution environment
- Call the provided tool functions directly; do not import them, assume a tools package exists, or modify module paths to locate them.
